name: Curse of the High Roller

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), chapter 15. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

summary: The casino's charm: the hero wants only to gamble, drink and flirt where they are. Every ten minutes they may shake it off; fail twice more and they are lost to it, with no more chances and no will to spoil the fun.
